prompt: A Submit button must stay disabled until the text field holds something other than spaces. Complete refreshSubmitState so the button's enabled state always matches the field.
explanation: A DocumentListener fires on every insert and remove, so calling the same refresh method from all three callbacks keeps the button in step with the text. trim() removes leading and trailing spaces so a field of blanks is treated as empty, and setEnabled(boolean) takes the result of that test directly instead of needing an if/else. Calling refreshSubmitState() once in the constructor sets the correct starting state before the user types anything.
hints: String.trim() strips the spaces off both ends, and isEmpty() tells you whether anything is left.
setEnabled takes a boolean, so you can pass the test result straight in -- no if statement needed.
The button should be enabled when the trimmed text is NOT empty, so negate the isEmpty() result.
